Class FarmLand

java.lang.Object
FarmLand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Insurable, Irrigable
public class FarmLand extends Object implements Irrigable, Insurable
Represents agricultural farm land that is both irrigable and insurable. Demonstrates Multiple Inheritance by implementing two interfaces: Irrigable and Insurable.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Mohammed Faaris Khan
